title: Sky Scene 9 — Night Sky Clues
purpose: Day/night vocabulary, multi-clue identification and simple inference.

sentenceModels: The satellite is high in the sky.
The owl is flying at night.

adultSupport.focus: Use clues about night, height and object type to find the right subject.
starterPrompts: What tells you it is night?
What is high near the stars?
expansionPrompts: What would be different in the daytime?
First point to the owl, then point to the satellite.

visualAudit: Reviewed in Wave 3 Batch 2 automatic pass against the visible teaching targets.
